name: ZCA_DOCSEQUENCE_CONFIG
description: ZCA_DOCSEQUENCE_CONFIG : This table would be used to store the document sequence configuration for Integration maps.

columns.name: DOC_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Stores the document sequence id of the record. This is the primary key.

columns.name: FORMAT
columns.description: Format for the document sequence.

columns.name: STARTVALUE
columns.description: Starting value of the sequence.

columns.name: MAXVALUE
columns.description: Maximum value that the sequence can have.

columns.name: STARTDATE
columns.description: Starting date of the document sequence.

columns.name: ENDDATE
columns.description: Ending date of the document sequence.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_TYPE
columns.description: Sequence type could be a table or a dbsequence.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the database sequence.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Object type of the document sequence.

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the table this sequence is used for.

columns.name: SEQ_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the table that contains the latest sequence value.

columns.name: SEQ_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: The column name of the table that contains the latest sequence value.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DOC_SEQ_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Document Sequence.

columns.name: PREFIX
columns.description: Prefix for the document sequence.

columns.name: STRIPE
columns.description: Stripe of the application.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Language Independent Code of the corresponding object.

columns.name: REST_RESOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Rest Resource Code using this document sequence.

columns.name: MONOLITH_CODE
columns.description: Monolith object definition.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the document sequence.
